road-photo: A two-lane country road at night, seen from low behind a car that stays out of frame. Only its dipped low-beam headlights reach forward: a short, soft, warm pool of light on damp asphalt that fades out within a few metres, the centre line catching the light and then disappearing. Beyond the pool the road runs on into gentle darkness under a faint tree line and a deep, calm night sky with no moon. The lit pool sits in the middle band of the frame; the top third is quiet dark sky and the bottom edge is quiet dark road. Palette: near-black night (#0C0C0E) and warm dark brown (#1D1714), with a single accent of lamp amber (#F2A54A) only in the headlight pool. Cinematic fine art photograph, wide composition, shallow depth of field, soft directional light, subtle film grain. No car body, no taillights, no people, no road signs, no city lights, no screens, no laptops, no hands, no sparkles, no arrows, no text, no logos.
road-linocut: Linocut print of a winding road through dark hills at night, seen from above at a gentle angle. One small car on the road, drawn as a simple carved shape; its low beams cast a short, soft fan of amber light on the road just ahead of it, and the fan stops well before the next bend. Hills, pines and the rest of the road are carved in fine parallel lines of near-black on a slightly lighter dark ground. The road and car sit in the middle band; the top is plain dark sky with a few carved stars, the bottom is plain dark hillside. Two-colour flat print: near-black (#0C0C0E) on warm dark brown (#1D1714), with lamp amber (#F2A54A) only in the beam. Hand-carved linocut, visible gouge marks, uneven ink, generous negative space. No screens, no laptops, no hands, no people, no sparkles, no arrows, no text, no logos.
road-aerial: Aerial photograph from high directly above at night: one thin road crosses a dark pine forest diagonally from lower left to upper right. A single car's dipped headlights make one small, soft teardrop of warm light on the road; the car itself is only a dark speck at its tip. The rest of the frame is calm, dark, textured tree canopy with no other lights. The teardrop sits a little left of centre in the middle band of the frame. Palette: near-black night (#0C0C0E) and warm dark brown (#1D1714), with a single accent of lamp amber (#F2A54A) only in the headlight light. Aerial photograph, graphic composition, calm even light, subtle grain.
